Study notes 📚 for a synthetic learner A short review session each day keeps the new cards from piling up. Cards you answer late come back sooner, and cards you know drift further out. Reading the notes before a session primes the words the session will show. A deck that grows faster than you review it becomes a backlog, not a habit. Retention is the share of reviews you answered correctly, not the number you saw. Leeches are cards you keep forgetting; rewriting them usually helps more than drilling.
